work.title: The Life and Death of King John

scene.label: Act 5, Scene 4

lines.text: I did not think the King so stor'd with friends.
lines.plainText: I did not think the King so stor'd with friends

lines.text: Up once again; put spirit in the French.
lines.plainText: Up once again put spirit in the French

lines.text: If they miscarry, we miscarry too.
lines.plainText: If they miscarry we miscarry too

lines.text: That misbegotten devil, Faulconbridge,
lines.plainText: That misbegotten devil Faulconbridge

lines.text: In spite of spite, alone upholds the day.
lines.plainText: In spite of spite alone upholds the day

lines.text: They say King John, sore sick, hath left the field.
lines.plainText: They say King John sore sick hath left the field

content.text: Enter Melun wounded, and led by Soldiers.

lines.text: Lead me to the revolts of England here.
lines.plainText: Lead me to the revolts of England here

lines.text: When we were happy we had other names.
lines.plainText: When we were happy we had other names

lines.text: It is the Count Melun.
lines.plainText: It is the Count Melun

lines.text: Wounded to death.
lines.plainText: Wounded to death

lines.text: Fly, noble English, you are bought and sold;
lines.plainText: Fly noble English you are bought and sold

lines.text: Unthread the rude eye of rebellion
lines.plainText: Unthread the rude eye of rebellion

lines.text: And welcome home again discarded faith.
lines.plainText: And welcome home again discarded faith

lines.text: Seek out King John and fall before his feet;
lines.plainText: Seek out King John and fall before his feet

lines.text: For if the French be lords of this loud day,
lines.plainText: For if the French be lords of this loud day

lines.text: He means to recompense the pains you take
lines.plainText: He means to recompense the pains you take

lines.text: By cutting off your heads. Thus hath he sworn,
lines.plainText: By cutting off your heads Thus hath he sworn

lines.text: And I with him, and many more with me,
lines.plainText: And I with him and many more with me

lines.text: Upon the altar at Saint Edmundsbury;
lines.plainText: Upon the altar at Saint Edmundsbury

lines.text: Even on that altar where we swore to you
lines.plainText: Even on that altar where we swore to you

lines.text: Dear amity and everlasting love.
lines.plainText: Dear amity and everlasting love

lines.text: May this be possible? May this be true?
lines.plainText: May this be possible May this be true

lines.text: Have I not hideous death within my view,
lines.plainText: Have I not hideous death within my view

lines.text: Retaining but a quantity of life,
lines.plainText: Retaining but a quantity of life

lines.text: Which bleeds away even as a form of wax
lines.plainText: Which bleeds away even as a form of wax

lines.text: Resolveth from his figure 'gainst the fire?
lines.plainText: Resolveth from his figure 'gainst the fire

lines.text: What in the world should make me now deceive,
lines.plainText: What in the world should make me now deceive

lines.text: Since I must lose the use of all deceit?
lines.plainText: Since I must lose the use of all deceit

lines.text: Why should I then be false, since it is true
lines.plainText: Why should I then be false since it is true

lines.text: That I must die here and live hence by truth?
lines.plainText: That I must die here and live hence by truth

lines.text: I say again, if Louis do win the day,
lines.plainText: I say again if Louis do win the day

lines.text: He is forsworn if e'er those eyes of yours
lines.plainText: He is forsworn if e'er those eyes of yours

lines.text: Behold another day break in the east.
lines.plainText: Behold another day break in the east

lines.text: But even this night, whose black contagious breath
lines.plainText: But even this night whose black contagious breath

lines.text: Already smokes about the burning crest
lines.plainText: Already smokes about the burning crest

lines.text: Of the old, feeble, and day-wearied sun,
lines.plainText: Of the old feeble and daywearied sun

lines.text: Even this ill night, your breathing shall expire,
lines.plainText: Even this ill night your breathing shall expire

lines.text: Paying the fine of rated treachery
lines.plainText: Paying the fine of rated treachery

lines.text: Even with a treacherous fine of all your lives,
lines.plainText: Even with a treacherous fine of all your lives

lines.text: If Louis by your assistance win the day.
lines.plainText: If Louis by your assistance win the day

lines.text: Commend me to one Hubert, with your king;
lines.plainText: Commend me to one Hubert with your king

lines.text: The love of him, and this respect besides,
lines.plainText: The love of him and this respect besides

lines.text: For that my grandsire was an Englishman,
lines.plainText: For that my grandsire was an Englishman

lines.text: Awakes my conscience to confess all this.
lines.plainText: Awakes my conscience to confess all this

lines.text: In lieu whereof, I pray you, bear me hence
lines.plainText: In lieu whereof I pray you bear me hence

lines.text: From forth the noise and rumour of the field,
lines.plainText: From forth the noise and rumour of the field

lines.text: Where I may think the remnant of my thoughts
lines.plainText: Where I may think the remnant of my thoughts

lines.text: In peace, and part this body and my soul
lines.plainText: In peace and part this body and my soul

lines.text: With contemplation and devout desires.
lines.plainText: With contemplation and devout desires

lines.text: We do believe thee, and beshrew my soul
lines.plainText: We do believe thee and beshrew my soul

lines.text: But I do love the favour and the form
lines.plainText: But I do love the favour and the form

lines.text: Of this most fair occasion, by the which
lines.plainText: Of this most fair occasion by the which

lines.text: We will untread the steps of damned flight,
lines.plainText: We will untread the steps of damned flight

lines.text: And like a bated and retired flood,
lines.plainText: And like a bated and retired flood

lines.text: Leaving our rankness and irregular course,
lines.plainText: Leaving our rankness and irregular course

lines.text: Stoop low within those bounds we have o'erlook'd,
lines.plainText: Stoop low within those bounds we have o'erlook'd

lines.text: And calmly run on in obedience
lines.plainText: And calmly run on in obedience

lines.text: Even to our ocean, to our great King John.
lines.plainText: Even to our ocean to our great King John

lines.text: My arm shall give thee help to bear thee hence;
lines.plainText: My arm shall give thee help to bear thee hence

lines.text: For I do see the cruel pangs of death
lines.plainText: For I do see the cruel pangs of death

lines.text: Right in thine eye.—Away, my friends! New flight,
lines.plainText: Right in thine eyeAway my friends New flight

lines.text: And happy newness, that intends old right.
lines.plainText: And happy newness that intends old right
